# Synthetic Portuguese audio fixtures

These files were generated locally with the Windows SAPI Microsoft Maria Desktop
Portuguese (Brazil) voice, using file output. They contain no customer recording
and do not imitate a member of the business. They are test inputs, not Orion voice
responses. Their presence does not prove recognition by a live provider.

| File | Intended utterance | Duration |
| --- | --- | --- |
| synthetic-price-pt.wav | Oi, quero saber quanto custa cortar o cabelo e fazer a barba. | 5.81 s |
| synthetic-correction-pt.wav | Quero corte e barba amanhã às duas. Não, melhor às três. E deixa só o corte mesmo. | 9.66 s |

Both files use PCM WAV, mono, 22050 Hz. The correction fixture intentionally lacks
an explicit morning/afternoon period: if the business's published hours cannot
resolve it, the assistant must clarify that detail before preparing a booking.
